title.en: AN ACT TO SUSPEND THE OPERATION OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY SEVEN, ENTITLED "AN ACT REGULATING THE REGISTRATION, BRANDING, CONVEYANCE, AND SLAUGHTER OF LARGE CATTLE," AND ALL AMENDMENTS THERETO, UNTIL THE FIRST DAY OF AUGUST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.

title.id: Undang-Undang menangguhkan penerapan Undang-Undang Nomor 637 berjudul 'Undang-Undang Mengatur Pendaftaran, Penandaan, Pengangkutan, dan Pemotongan Ternak Besar' serta semua amandemennya hingga 1 Agustus 1903
title.ms: Akta menangguhkan operasi Akta Nombor 637 yang bertajuk 'Akta Mengawal Pendaftaran, Penandaan, Pengangkutan dan Penyembelihan Haiwan Besar' dan semua pindaannya sehingga 1 Ogos 1903

text.en:
The operation of Act Numbered Six hundred and thirty-seven, entitled "An Act regulating the
registration, branding, conveyance, and slaughter of large cattle," and of all amendments thereto, is hereby
suspended until the first day of August, nineteen hundred and three.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 1, 1903.
